title: Filtering the sales table by numbers · part 13

steps.title: Keep id >= 41
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where id is at least 41.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE id >= 41;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sales.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is id >= 41.
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE id >= 41;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE id >= 41;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.

steps.title: Count rows id >= 41
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE id >= 41;
hints: Start with SELECT count(*).
FROM sales.
Add WHERE id >= 41.
Write: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE id >= 41;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales WHERE id >= 41;
steps.memory_trick: count(*) + WHERE = 'how many pass?'
